request: What impact did passing Obamacare have on the federal budget?

reply.reply:
Under CBO and JCT’s February 2011 baseline, the Affordable Care Act was projected to reduce federal deficits by $210 billion over FY2012–FY2021 (CRS R41664, PDF p. 7). That net projection included $1,390 billion in gross insurance-coverage expansion costs over the same period (CRS R41664, PDF p. 7). Separately, health-related revenue provisions were projected to raise $391.7 billion over 10 years (CRS R41128, PDF p. 4).

These were projections—not a retrospective tally of actual budget outcomes. See the [full brief](output/briefs/case-20261021-163244-f6dc.html).
reply.reasoning: Verified CRS findings report a projected net deficit reduction and separately stated gross coverage costs and health-related revenues; the brief notes the estimates’ baseline and projection caveats.
